reference_policy: The user catalog image was used only as a quality and category benchmark. Every building and lot is an original Cedar Market design.
prompt_set: Original cream clapboard craftsman cottage with slate-blue gable roof, porch, bay window, chimney, garden and stone walk on a coherent 2x2 lot.
Original three-home brick and cream rowhouse terrace with stoops, dormers, window boxes, bicycles and clipped planting on a coherent 2x3 lot.
Original four-story terracotta and teal courtyard apartments with rooftop garden, solar panels, balconies, benches and layered planting on a coherent 3x3 lot.
Original cream limestone and brick neighborhood library with hipped slate roof, accessible entrance, benches, bicycle rack and gardens on a coherent 3x3 lot.
Original limestone and terracotta city hall with mansard roof, copper-domed clock tower, portico, fountain and formal gardens on a coherent 4x4 plaza lot.
shared_prompt_constraints: Match the Cedar Market siblings exactly: fixed 3/4 isometric 2:1 camera, readable roof and two facades, warm detailed materials, northwest key, southeast contact shadow, no perspective distortion, rotation, skew, text, watermark, UI, sprite sheet or neighboring buildings; flat #ff00ff source backdrop for local alpha extraction.
processing: The required Pillow helper was attempted first but unavailable in the shell runtime. The checked-in deterministic Sharp processor performs border-connected chroma removal and canonical footprint normalization; it does not rotate, skew, or apply renderer scale overrides.
